_about.generated_by: hand-recorded operator readings; no committed script produces them, so each block names the read-only command that read it on makelab2
_about.host: makelab2 (the catalog host), catalog opened mode=ro

attempts_by_night.command: for d in 2026-10-15 2026-10-22 2026-10-23; do for ch in kartaview kartaview_streets; do ls logs/collect_*_${ch}_${d}.log | wc -l; done; grep -l 404 logs/collect_*_kartaview*_${d}.log | wc -l; done
attempts_by_night.note: One child log per (city, channel, night), so a file is one attempt; files_with_404 is the grep count. The night summaries corroborate: 189 - 65 = 124 and 157 - 21 = 136 failed runs.

requests_ledgered.command: sqlite3 'file:data/streetscape_tracker.db?mode=ro' "select usage_date, provider, requests from api_usage where provider like 'kartaview%' and usage_date in ('2026-10-15','2026-10-22','2026-10-23')"

night_summaries.2026-10-22: 65/189 runs succeeded across 80 cities in 2.09 h; fill not reached (the due slate ended the night); stopped early (city cap reached (80))
night_summaries.2026-10-23: 21/157 runs succeeded across 80 cities in 1.60 h; fill not reached (the due slate ended the night); stopped early (city cap reached (80))

consecutive_failures_after_pause.command: sqlite3 'file:data/streetscape_tracker.db?mode=ro' "select provider, consecutive_failures, count(*) from schedule_state join cities using(city_id) where cities.enabled=1 and provider like 'kartaview%' group by 1,2"

last_success_at.command: sqlite3 'file:data/streetscape_tracker.db?mode=ro' "select provider, max(last_success_at) from schedule_state where provider like 'kartaview%' group by 1"
